none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize a convex objective over the closed ℓ₁ ball of radius R; every component is globally convex and has globally L-Lipschitz Euclidean gradient.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: The objective is F(x)=(1/n)∑ᵢ fᵢ(x), with n>0.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query selects an index i and feasible point x and returns exactly ∇fᵢ(x). No component values are supplied; replies are independent of history and oracle seed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: Queries and outputs must satisfy ∥x∥₁≤R, while component gradient smoothness is measured in the Euclidean norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is ℝᵈ with Euclidean norm, d>0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d,n,L,R,ε are public and strictly positive. The component functions are hidden. No gradient magnitude or initial objective-gap bound is assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/FiniteSumNondualSmoothConvex.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: A measurable feasible output X must have integrable objective gap F(X)−F(x⋆) for a constrained minimizer x⋆.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[F(X)−F(x⋆)]≤ε under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness, with a fixed component-gradient query budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex finite-sum minimization over a known ℓ₁ ball with exact component-gradient access and expected objective accuracy is an established constrained optimization formulation; its constraint geometry differs from its Euclidean smoothness geometry.
